info.name: ERPAPI (MassERP)
info.description: MassERP API. 1) Set collection variables loginId/password to a TEST account. 2) Run 'Authentication > Login - Valid' (saves accessToken). 3) Run the Employees requests. Never commit real credentials.

response.name: Login - Valid
Login - Invalid Password
Login - Invalid Username

item.name: Refresh - old token after 30 s - 401 REUSED (ends session)

exec:
pm.test('Status is 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Message Logged out.', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.eql('Logged out.'));

response.name: Refresh after logout - 401 INVALID

item.name: Employees

exec: pm.test('Has branches/departments/nationalities/statuses', () => { const d = pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.branches).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.departments).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.nationalities).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(d.statuses).to.be.an('array'); });
